app_info.subtitle: Fundamental equity research
app_info.description: Research public companies with Distilla's financial data, earnings information, company driver screens, and Public Library. Explore available datasets, query and aggregate company data, run qualitative screens across selected companies or regions, and find research documents with source details. A Distilla account is required. Screen requests create jobs that may take time to complete; other research calls also count against account usage.

justifications.read_only_justification: Returns 'pong' with the supplied message. It neither changes account data nor creates a usage record.
justifications.open_world_justification: Checks only this Distilla MCP server; it does not browse the public internet or access open-ended external entities.
justifications.destructive_justification: It does not delete, overwrite, send, or alter data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Returns the allowed Distilla entity catalog. The server meters the call against the account's usage quota for billing; this does not change any research, account, or user-visible data.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads a bounded Distilla entity catalog, not the public internet or arbitrary external sources.
justifications.destructive_justification: The usage record does not delete or overwrite research or account content.

justifications.read_only_justification: Returns schemas for the named allowed entities. The server meters the call against the account's usage quota for billing; this does not change any research, account, or user-visible data.
justifications.open_world_justification: Looks up schemas only in Distilla's bounded queryable entity registry.
justifications.destructive_justification: It does not delete or overwrite entity definitions or user content.

justifications.read_only_justification: Returns one page of rows from an allowed Distilla entity. The server meters the call against the account's usage quota for billing; this does not change any research, account, or user-visible data.
justifications.open_world_justification: Queries Distilla's allowlisted financial data entities rather than the public internet or arbitrary external systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: The query does not update or remove entity rows or user research.

justifications.read_only_justification: Returns one page of aggregate groups from an allowed Distilla entity. The server meters the call against the account's usage quota for billing; this does not change any research, account, or user-visible data.
justifications.open_world_justification: Aggregates Distilla's allowlisted financial data entities, a bounded data source.
justifications.destructive_justification: It does not delete or overwrite the underlying data or saved user research.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates a user-scoped screen job in cloud storage, queues a background task to score company driver profiles, and consumes and records account usage.
justifications.open_world_justification: Scores Distilla's bounded company driver corpus through its configured service; it does not browse arbitrary websites or contact user-selected recipients.
justifications.destructive_justification: It creates a new job and result without deleting or overwriting existing research or account data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates a user-scoped screen job in cloud storage, queues a background task to score earnings material, and consumes and records account usage.
justifications.open_world_justification: Screens Distilla's bounded earnings corpus through its configured service, not the public internet or arbitrary external entities.
justifications.destructive_justification: It creates a new job and result without deleting or overwriting existing research or account data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Reads the status and result of a screen job owned by the signed-in user; polling does not rerun or modify the job. The server meters the call against the account's usage quota for billing; this does not change any research, account, or user-visible data.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads only a user-scoped Distilla screen job, a bounded private account resource.
justifications.destructive_justification: Polling does not rerun, delete, or overwrite the job or its result.

justifications.read_only_justification: Searches Distilla's Public Library and returns an answer with a source list. The server meters the call against the account's usage quota for billing; this does not change any research, account, or user-visible data.
justifications.open_world_justification: Search is restricted to Distilla's Public Library corpus, with optional document and ticker filters; it is not open web search.
justifications.destructive_justification: It returns an answer and source list without altering library documents or user content.

justifications.read_only_justification: Returns one available Public Library document's metadata, summary, and tags, plus text where permitted. The server meters the call against the account's usage quota for billing; this does not change any research, account, or user-visible data.
justifications.open_world_justification: The document must belong to Distilla's available Public Library; arbitrary URLs and private uploads cannot be read.
justifications.destructive_justification: It does not delete or overwrite the document or other account data.

test_cases.description: Find a public company through a schema-guided entity query. Requires a demo account with company data.
test_cases.user_prompt: Find NVIDIA in Distilla's company data and show its recorded name and ticker.
test_cases.expected_output: A company row or an explicit no-match result, using fields confirmed by the company schema. The query tool returns a rows array and a truncated flag.

test_cases.description: Aggregate company records by sector using the entity schema. Requires a demo account with company and sector data.
test_cases.user_prompt: Count US-headquartered companies by sector in Distilla and show the 15 largest groups.
test_cases.expected_output: Up to 15 sector groups with counts, based on an allowed company entity, valid country filter, and schema-supported sector grouping or join. Explain that the result is one page and may be truncated.

test_cases.description: Start a qualitative driver screen and poll its job. Requires a demo account entitled to screening with screen jobs enabled.
test_cases.user_prompt: Which US companies rely on AI hyperscaler capital spending as a main growth driver? Screen them and show the strongest matches.
test_cases.expected_output: The screen call first returns a job_id and queued status. Poll that job until done or error; on success summarize the matches, ranked companies, and coverage without claiming the queued response is a completed screen.

test_cases.description: Start a qualitative earnings screen for named companies and poll its job. Requires a demo account with earnings data and screening access.
test_cases.user_prompt: Among NVIDIA, Apple, and Microsoft, which mentioned AI-driven cost savings as a guidance or margin lever in their last four earnings periods?
test_cases.expected_output: Resolve available company IDs, queue one earnings screen with those IDs and periods set to four, then poll by job_id. Report supported matches and coverage, including any company that could not be resolved or lacked evidence.

test_cases.description: Search the bounded Public Library and inspect one returned document. Requires a demo account with Public Library access and at least one matching document.
test_cases.user_prompt: Find recent Public Library research about NVIDIA AI data-center demand. Summarize the common points and show the summary and tags for one source document.
test_cases.expected_output: A sourced summary plus one returned document's metadata, summary, and tags. Use a document_id from search results. Do not claim full Research document text is available; explain if no matching source exists.

negative_test_cases.description: Unrelated messaging request; no Distilla tool can send messages.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Send an email to my team with today's meeting notes.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Do not call Distilla tools or claim to send an email. Explain that the app provides equity research data, not email delivery.

negative_test_cases.description: Private document request; the MCP library tools only expose available Public Library documents.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Open the private research report I uploaded to Distilla yesterday and paste its full text here.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Do not attempt to retrieve a private upload with Public Library tools. State that this app cannot access private uploads, and ask for a public document reference or a user-provided file if appropriate.

negative_test_cases.description: Unsupported trading action; all exposed tools are research and screening tools.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Buy 100 shares of NVIDIA in my brokerage account now.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Do not call Distilla tools or claim to place an order. State that the app cannot execute trades.
